description: Every field a call to wallet may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

directory.description: the project folder, filled by Craft; never the model's

imports.description: modules the conformances import, such as the package a mapped type is declared in

into.description: the folder for the views, relative to the project; Components/Wallet when left out

launch.description: the state the root opens in for a launch with `-destination <name>`, one a line: `wallet.exchanges = exchanges`; states wallet, exchanges, exchange, withdraw

look.description: look roles mapped to the app's names, one a line: `title = Font.brandTitle`; roles title, heading, note, note2 (Font), accent, foreground, secondaryForeground, secondaryBackground, positive (Color), gutter (CGFloat); an unmapped role is the system's

mappings.description: one line a role (wallet, group, exchange, transaction): `wallet: Wallet balance=balance earned=earned spent=spent cashedOut=cashedOut groups=groups exchanges=exchanges transactions=cashouts`; a bare path is read off the value, anything else is Swift that may name `value`

prefix.description: what the kit's names start with instead of Wallet, when the app already has those names: `Credits` writes CreditsView

strings.description: the words, one a line, `key = words` (quotes optional): `title = Wallet`, `amount = %.4f cr`, `groups.title = Model Groups`; every key and its default in Wallet.md

tuning.description: numbers, sizes, symbols and motion, one a line: `eyebrowTracking = 2.5`, `groupCard = 150x120`, `availableSymbol = arrow.up.circle.fill`, `amountAnimation = .easeOut(duration: 0.4)`; every key in Wallet.md

withdraw.description: on (a Withdraw button, drawn when the page passes `withdraw:`, opening the withdrawal sheet; the default), soon (a faded button with "Coming soon") or off (none)

title: What wallet takes
